description: Cleared Check — verify an origin before pay. Returns pass, score, payToMismatch, tier, card URL, provenance, nextAction (route_gateway + fee on PASS), and defaultNextTool=route_gateway. probe.description: Live-probe endpoints (default false — prefer false for agent farms)
